rows.headline: Thoma Bravo to take Accelerant private in more than $4 billion deal
rows.prelim_note: M&A / capital structure: all-cash take-private at $20.25/share, a ~49% premium to the Aug 12 close, just over a year after Accelerant's IPO.

rows.headline: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
rows.prelim_note: Shifts analyst expectations: Q2 revenue of $180M missed the $194M LSEG consensus even as FY26 core-revenue guidance was raised to $880-890M.

rows.headline: CoreWeave Q2 2026 earnings: revenue beats, losses widen
rows.prelim_note: Margin/cash-flow signal: revenue +112% YoY to $2.58B but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 59% from 62% and net loss widened to $626M on rising debt financing costs.

rows.headline: What's Going On With Globant Stock On Friday?
rows.prelim_note: Guidance cut: FY26 revenue guide lowered to $2.428-2.462B (from $2.462-2.508B), stock fell ~14% after-hours Aug 13 on New Markets and travel softness.

rows.headline: Apple Stock Stalls as Jefferies Cuts Target to $263.66
rows.prelim_note: Shifts analyst expectations: Jefferies downgraded Apple to Underperform and cut its price target to $263.66 from $285.56 on iPhone-cycle valuation concerns.

rows.headline: DA Davidson cuts Shift4 Payments stock price target on Iran conflict
rows.prelim_note: Guidance cut + estimate revision: management lowered 2026 guidance citing the Iran conflict and FX headwinds; DA Davidson cut its target to $68 from $74, shares fell 5.8%.

rows.headline: Swissquote shares sink 10% as crypto slump prompts 2026 guidance cut
rows.prelim_note: Guidance cut: FY26 net revenue guide lowered to ~CHF 730M and pre-tax profit to ~CHF 365M after H1 crypto income fell 66%; shares fell as much as 14%.

rows.headline: Bearish: Analysts Just Cut Their UWM Holdings Corporation (NYSE:UWMC) Revenue and EPS estimates
rows.prelim_note: Shifts analyst expectations: stock fell 35% after a Q2 EPS miss despite a revenue beat; FY26 consensus moved to a loss of $0.11/share (from +$0.36) and the consensus price target fell 43% to $2.22.

rows.headline: Voda Idea soars 4% on huge volume in weak market; up for 6th straight day
rows.prelim_note: Cash-flow / margin signal: Q1FY27 net loss narrowed to Rs 3,754 crore from Rs 6,608 crore YoY, helped by an Rs 1,611 crore fair-value gain and rising 4G/5G ARPU.
